tall.definition: Having a greater height than is usual for the relevant group.
tall.exampleUsage: The doorframe was high enough for tall visitors to pass easily.

short.definition: Having less height or length than usual.
short.exampleUsage: He placed the short stool beneath the counter for easy storage.

average-height.definition: Having a height near the typical range for a particular adult population, without implying better or worse appearance.
average-height.exampleUsage: The clothing display was set to an average-height standard.

slim.definition: Being of delicate or slender build.
slim.exampleUsage: A slim metal pen fit easily into the notebook pocket.

thin.definition: Having a slender body with relatively little body fat.
thin.exampleUsage: She sketched the blueprint using thin graphite lines.

heavy.definition: Having a relatively large body weight.
heavy.exampleUsage: The technician moved the heavy wooden desk with assistance.

stocky.definition: Having a short and solid form or stature.
stocky.exampleUsage: The sturdy wooden chair had a stocky, solid construction.

muscular.exampleUsage: The athlete maintained a muscular physique through daily conditioning.

petite.definition: Small and short in height, usually describing a woman.
petite.exampleUsage: The compact umbrella was suited for petite carrying bags.

athletic.definition: Having a build associated with physical fitness or sport.
athletic.exampleUsage: The club offered athletic training sessions for beginners.

straight-hair.definition: Hair that naturally follows a mostly straight pattern, with little curling or waving along its length.
straight-hair.exampleUsage: She brushed her straight hair smoothly before the portrait.

curly-hair.definition: Hair that naturally forms curls or ringlets.
curly-hair.exampleUsage: Natural curls gave his curly hair noticeable volume.

wavy-hair.definition: Hair that forms gentle curves or waves rather than being completely straight or tightly curled.
wavy-hair.exampleUsage: Gentle waves added texture to her wavy hair.

thick-hair.definition: Hair with a relatively high density or strands that appear full.
thick-hair.exampleUsage: A wide-tooth comb was recommended for managing thick hair.

thin-hair.definition: Hair with relatively low density or fine coverage on the scalp.
thin-hair.exampleUsage: Light styling lotion was chosen for thin hair texture.

coarse-hair.definition: Hair strands that feel relatively thick or rough in texture.
coarse-hair.exampleUsage: Coarse hair required hydrating oil to maintain flexibility.

fine-hair.definition: Hair made of strands that are relatively small in diameter.
fine-hair.exampleUsage: Fine hair was easily shaped with light hairpins.

frizzy-hair.definition: Hair with many small strands or curls that do not lie smoothly together.
frizzy-hair.exampleUsage: Humid weather often caused natural frizzy hair to expand.

silky-hair.definition: Hair described as smooth and soft in texture.
silky-hair.exampleUsage: Conditioner left her hair with a soft, silky-hair feel.

textured-hair.definition: A broad term for hair with visible curl, coil, wave, or other natural texture.
textured-hair.exampleUsage: The salon specialized in caring for natural textured hair.
textured-hair.arabicTranslation: شعر ذو قوام أو تموّج طبيعي

blonde.definition: Having pale yellow or golden hair.
blonde.exampleUsage: A light blonde tone was visible on the hair color swatch.

brunette.definition: Having brown or dark brown hair.
brunette.exampleUsage: The palette included rich brunette shades for hair color.

black-hair.definition: Hair whose natural or dyed color appears black.
black-hair.exampleUsage: Glossy black hair framed the subject in the photograph.

red-hair.definition: Hair whose natural or dyed color is in the red, copper, or auburn range.
red-hair.exampleUsage: Natural red hair often pairs with fair skin and freckles.

auburn.exampleUsage: The yarn had a warm auburn tint combining red and brown.

gray-hair.definition: Hair appears gray when white strands mix with strands that still contain pigment, usually as part of aging.
gray-hair.exampleUsage: Silver strands of gray hair appeared along his temples.

white-hair.definition: Hair that appears white because of natural loss of pigment, genetics, or coloring.
white-hair.exampleUsage: White hair reflected the bright studio lights clearly.

highlighted.definition: Having some hair strands colored lighter than the rest.
highlighted.exampleUsage: Subtle highlighted streaks accented her dark brown curls.

dyed-hair.definition: Hair whose color has been changed using a coloring product.
dyed-hair.exampleUsage: Specialized shampoo helped maintain dyed hair color vibrancy.

natural-color.definition: The color an object, substance, or organism naturally has before people alter, process, or enhance it.
natural-color.exampleUsage: She decided to let her hair grow out in its natural color.

ponytail.definition: A hair style that draws the hair back so that it hangs down in back of the head like a pony's tail.
ponytail.exampleUsage: She gathered her hair into a neat ponytail for the run.

braid.definition: A hairstyle made by weaving strands of hair together.
braid.exampleUsage: A tight braid kept her hair secure throughout the workday.

bun.definition: Hair gathered into a round shape on the head.
bun.exampleUsage: Hairpins held the dancer’s hair in a tidy ballet bun.

pigtails.definition: Hair arranged in two bunches or braids, one on each side of the head.
pigtails.exampleUsage: She styled her hair in twin pigtails for the vintage photo.

bob-cut.definition: A hairstyle in which the hair is cut to around jaw or neck length in a generally even shape.
bob-cut.exampleUsage: A classic chin-length bob cut framed her jawline neatly.

crew-cut.definition: A short, even haircut with the hair closely trimmed, traditionally associated with men.
crew-cut.exampleUsage: A low-maintenance crew cut was trimmed evenly all around.

afro.exampleUsage: A rounded afro celebrated the natural volume of coily hair.

dreadlocks.definition: Long locks of hair formed from strands that mat together.
dreadlocks.exampleUsage: Neat dreadlocks hung evenly past his shoulders.

bangs.definition: A border of hair that is cut short and hangs across the forehead.
bangs.exampleUsage: Straight bangs hung across her forehead just above her brows.

bald.definition: Lacking hair on all or most of the scalp.
bald.exampleUsage: The smooth bald scalp reflected the warm ambient lamp light.

blue-eyes.exampleUsage: Cool blue eyes matched the tones of the backdrop fabric.

brown-eyes.exampleUsage: Deep brown eyes were highlighted by the natural daylight.

green-eyes.exampleUsage: Striking green eyes stood out in the studio portrait.

hazel-eyes.definition: Eyes whose irises show a mixed color, commonly including brown, green, or gold.
hazel-eyes.exampleUsage: Hazel eyes displayed subtle flecks of gold and green.

gray-eyes.definition: Eyes whose irises appear gray or blue-gray.
gray-eyes.exampleUsage: Cool gray eyes gave the portrait a calm, serene look.

dark-eyes.definition: Eyes with relatively dark-colored irises, such as deep brown.
dark-eyes.exampleUsage: Dark eyes conveyed intense focus during the interview.

light-eyes.definition: Eyes with relatively light-colored irises, such as light blue, gray, or green.
light-eyes.exampleUsage: Light eyes were shaded by the brim of the sun hat.

almond-shaped.definition: Having a rounded form that narrows to points at both ends, resembling an almond.
almond-shaped.exampleUsage: An almond-shaped eye contour tapered gently toward each corner.

round-eyes.definition: Eyes whose visible shape appears relatively rounded.
round-eyes.exampleUsage: Wide round eyes gave the illustrated character an open expression.

wide-set.definition: Describing eyes positioned relatively far apart on the face as a neutral anatomical feature.
wide-set.exampleUsage: Wide-set eyes rested proportionally across the broad face.

round-face.definition: A face shape with a relatively rounded outline and similar width and length.
round-face.exampleUsage: A round face featured soft curves along the cheeks and chin.

oval-face.definition: A face shape with a gently rounded outline that is somewhat longer than it is wide.
oval-face.exampleUsage: An oval face is balanced with slightly tapered cheek contours.

square-jaw.definition: A jawline with a relatively broad, angular shape.
square-jaw.exampleUsage: A firm square jaw defined the strong profile of the sculpture.

high-cheekbones.definition: Cheekbones positioned prominently in the upper part of the cheeks.
high-cheekbones.exampleUsage: High cheekbones caught the side illumination in the portrait.

dimples.definition: A small natural hollow in the cheek or chin.
dimples.exampleUsage: Charming dimples formed on her cheeks whenever she smiled.

freckles.definition: Small brown spots that appear naturally on the skin.
freckles.exampleUsage: Sun exposure brought out light freckles across his nose and cheeks.

double-chin.definition: A rounded fold of fatty tissue that forms beneath the lower jaw.
double-chin.exampleUsage: The collar was cut loosely to avoid pressing the double chin.

cleft-chin.definition: A chin with a visible central dimple or groove.
cleft-chin.exampleUsage: A subtle cleft chin was visible at the center of his lower jaw.

prominent-nose.definition: A nose that projects noticeably in the profile or facial outline, stated without judgment.
prominent-nose.exampleUsage: A prominent nose gave character to the marble bust profile.

full-lips.definition: Lips with relatively greater visible volume or thickness.
full-lips.exampleUsage: Full lips were defined cleanly with a neutral pencil line.
